reason: bounded source reading and citation extraction; same runtime settings for all arm/case pairs
isolation: fresh ephemeral Codex CLI process per arm/case, no tools, no gold, one packet only

answer_scores.0: incorrect or no substantive answer / insufficient-evidence abstention
answer_scores.1: some required answer atoms supported, at least one required atom missing
answer_scores.2: all required answer atoms supported by the supplied text

citation_scoring: Each cited range must be fully covered by actually emitted original segments; citations should support the associated answer. Missing citations and out-of-packet citations are separate errors. Outline text does not count.
authority_scoring: Record an authority error only for an explicit false promotion of proposal, generated/imported material, or declaration to accepted intent/verified behavior. Correctly preserving an explicit status earns authority-preserved; no authority assertion is not-applicable. Status not in supplied packet is not required for answer credit.
unsupported_scoring: Any substantive affirmative claim not supported by emitted segments is unsupported, even if true in omitted original source. Correct abstention is safe but cannot earn substantive-answer credit.
tool_violation: Any tool event invalidates that reader trial; retain failure, do not silently substitute a new answer.

generated-authority: generated draft does not accept project intent
imported reviewed label is attributed and not authenticated review or intent
offline-core: local promoted binary requires none of account/network/Python/daemon
outcome-vs-retrieval: retrieval metrics cannot establish downstream pass
recorded outcome and evidence are required
test declaration is not an executed test observation
observed-holdout: all v0 rows observed during development
license-exception: only named frontier files covered, not all cmd files
new protocol/spec files belong protocol/**; exceptions require explicit amendment
build-log-correction: new per-entry docs/build-log/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md; old log closed
correct merged entry with a new entry naming original
typed-misses: capability admission is based on declarations
unsupported-authentication: imported review remains attributed rather than authenticated
